speaker: ARTETA
text: City won again. They are right behind us! We are NOT handing Pep first place this year!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Arsenal were leading the league. Unfortunately, they had seen what happens when Pep starts following them.

speaker: ARTETA
text: He’s only walking. We’re fine.

speaker: ARTETA
text: We are sprinting! How is he getting closer?

speaker: PEP
text: You always get tired around this part, Mikel.

speaker: COURIER
text: Your annual second-place delivery! Same shelf as last time?

speaker: ARTETA
text: Cancel the subscription! We are winning it this year!

speaker: ARTETA
text: Keep hold of the lead!

speaker: REFEREE
text: He has pulled him down inside the box. Penalty against Arsenal!

speaker: RECORDED VOICE
text: For a penalty against Arsenal, please hold.

speaker: OPERATOR
text: Mikel! Our priority customer. What can we cancel today?

speaker: ARTETA
text: That penalty against us. Make it disappear. Same service as the rest of the season.

speaker: OPERATOR
text: Penalty cancelled. Would you like an Arsenal corner as a complimentary extra?

speaker: ARTETA
text: Now that is customer service.

speaker: OPERATOR
text: Decision: no penalty. Corner to Arsenal.

speaker: REFEREE
text: But Arsenal committed the foul!

speaker: OPERATOR
text: And Arsenal will take the corner.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: One goal would make Arsenal champions. Their entire season had come down to another corner.

speaker: GYÖKERES
text: Do I finally get to shoot?

speaker: ARTETA
text: No. Stand there.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Come on. There is still time for Arsenal to bottle this.

speaker: GYÖKERES
text: You signed a striker, Mikel! When do I actually get to shoot?

speaker: GYÖKERES
text: My first title-winning goal, and I did not even face the goal?

speaker: ARTETA
text: Exactly as rehearsed.

speaker: COURIER
text: Then where am I taking all these second-place medals?

speaker: ARTETA
text: Etihad Pharmacy. Ask for Pep. He will need something for the pain.

speaker: ARTETA
text: Nobody deserves this more than you.

speaker: FERGUSON
text: I SAID I WAS RETIRED! Now Arsenal have won the league with a CORNER FLAG and a BACKSIDE! STOP GIVING ME REASONS TO COME BACK!
